Remark
[Symmetric operators and eigenfunction bases] ↗ thm:parabolic-improved-regularity 1. ch7:7.1.3-rem-3\group Regularity

When $L$ is symmetric, the Galerkin basis may be chosen as an $H_0^1(U)$ eigenfunction basis of $L$, eliminating estimate (54).
